title: Vinyume (Theme 10: Kujithamini)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child gives the noun or adjective of the opposite meaning (not a synonym, not a negative) with the right class prefix.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "nyumba ndogo" and two nouns with their opposites.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kinyume cha neno ni nini?" Kwa nini "Neno lenye maana sawa" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kinyume cha neno ni neno lenye maana kinyume, kama kubwa na dogo.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kinyume cha mrefu ni kipi?" Kwa nini "mnene" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Kinyume cha mchana ni kipi?" Kwa nini "asubuhi" si jibu sahihi?

misconceptions.repair: Kinyume huhifadhi kiambishi cha ngeli: mti mfupi.
